scope: Direct answer-generation intervention only; the independent 400-question replication is confirmatory and the initial 200-question result is exploratory.

generation.decoding: greedy (do_sample=False); temperature is not a generation parameter in the actual call, so it is deterministic rather than an explicitly supplied temperature=0.
generation.prompt: Same short-answer few-shot system+user prompt and source-pair template_id for baseline, +v, and -v within every paired question.
generation.intervention: Add ±alpha*v_norm at L18 layer output for the prompt prefill and every cached decoding forward pass.

scoring.answer_extraction: First generated line after stripping common chatty prefixes.
scoring.correctness: SQuAD-style lowercase/punctuation/article/whitespace normalization followed by exact equality to any TriviaQA gold alias.
scoring.empty_outputs: Excluded only if either member of a paired comparison has an empty normalized answer; none were excluded in the reported three rows.
scoring.test: Two-sided exact McNemar/binomial test on paired discordant outcomes.

conclusion: The independent 400-question confirmation shows no direct-generation accuracy improvement: +v delta=-.0025 (p=1.0) and -v delta=+.0025 (p=1.0).
